fit.gap_handling_summary: The outputs establish a strong React/TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, testing and mobile-performance match. They retain WCAG 2.1 AA rather than upgrading it to 2.2 AA, and use real fintech safeguards as transferable experience without claiming healthcare, GDPR or audit expertise. The letter explicitly expresses willingness to learn health-data privacy requirements. Semantic HTML, responsive layouts, OWASP knowledge, design-system ownership and integration testing remain incompletely evidenced rather than fabricated.

artefacts: The PDF contains 'Freelance Developer | |', with empty employer/location separators absent from the supplied CV text.
issues: The Nordkust role heading and dates are stranded at the bottom of page 1 while every responsibility appears on page 2.
The skills inventory is broad and dense; several older technologies and the driving licence add little to this application.
The education dates are followed by a redundant 'Graduated 2014' line.
Next.js appears without its marketing-page scope in the CV, although the letter correctly supplies that qualification.

reasons: The single-column PDF extracts in a sensible sequence with intact words, dates and conventional section headings.
The core stack, professional experience, Jest, Playwright, cloud tooling and quantified outcomes are prominent.
Coverage credits clear semantic equivalents: BankID identity verification for authentication, GitHub/GitLab workflows for Git, and 'Mentor' for mentoring.
HTML, WCAG 2.1 AA, Storybook and Supertest provide adjacent evidence, but do not independently establish semantic HTML, WCAG 2.2 AA, design-system experience or explicit integration-testing practice.
Several missing terms are genuine evidence gaps and should not be inserted merely to increase keyword coverage.

issues: The sentence joining the conversion and LCP results loses its grammatical subject: 'onboarding conversion increased ... and improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint'.
The long third paragraph combines collaboration, migration, security, motivation and five additional technologies; splitting or trimming it would improve readability.
Much of the letter repeats CV achievements, with less emphasis on how the candidate would collaborate on patient-facing work.
Company specificity is accurate but mainly limited to the patient-experience mission and stated principles, rather than a particular product or recent initiative.
strengths: Names Verdane Care and the Patient Experience role correctly.
Connects measurable mobile performance and accessibility work to patient-facing engineering.
Uses concrete sensitive-data safeguards rather than unsupported compliance claims.
Clearly distinguishes transferable fintech experience from health-data privacy requirements still to learn.
Correctly describes Next.js as server-rendered marketing-page experience.
Avoids the obsolete agency-to-product and 'excited to learn NestJS' framing from the earlier letter.

spacing_issues: The Nordkust job heading and dates are orphaned at the bottom of CV page 1, with its bullets beginning page 2.
CV page 1 is dense while page 2 is only 47.6% filled; moving the entire Nordkust entry to page 2 would improve balance.
The cover letter's large third paragraph is visually heavier than the surrounding paragraphs.
consistency_issues: The freelance heading displays empty vertical-bar separators, unlike the completed employer/location headings.
issues: The CV's 10-point body is readable but relatively compact, especially in the uninterrupted skills inventory.
Both documents use compatible serif typography and restrained formatting, although the letter does not repeat the CV's contact header.
The work-arrangement source supports both Graz hybrid work and fully remote work within Austria, Germany, Croatia or Slovenia; the single arrangement enum cannot express both.

grammar_and_spelling_errors: Cover letter: 'onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74%, and improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds.' Correct to: 'onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74%. I also improved mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds.'
fluency_and_tone_issues: 'I also work closely ... I’ve helped ... I also built ...' produces repetitive sentence openings in the third paragraph.

'while applying the careful handling of sensitive data I have used in fintech onboarding' is cumbersome; 'bringing the secure data-handling practices I use in fintech onboarding' would be more natural.

notes_facts_used: Twelve years of professional experience counted from 2014.
Frontend is the candidate's strongest area.
Apollo Server BFF maintenance is presented with appropriate scope.
Four months of acting team-lead duties in 2024, including one-to-ones and sprint planning.
notes_facts_ignored: The candidate is targeting senior full-stack or senior frontend opportunities; the headline follows the advertised role without highlighting that senior positioning.

parsed.summary: These are credible, well-targeted documents with strong evidence for the core React/TypeScript, NestJS and PostgreSQL stack, plus unusually useful conversion and mobile-performance results. Candidate claims are grounded, temporary leadership is scoped correctly, and the letter does not inflate WCAG 2.1 experience into WCAG 2.2 or fintech safeguards into healthcare compliance expertise. The main corrections are an orphaned job heading, empty separators in the CV PDF, and a grammatical error joining two results in the letter. The outputs make no unsupported relocation or remote-work commitment; the candidate's stated address alone is not a work-arrangement conflict.
